title: Add in-content internal link from top guide blog post to /star-map-generator
description:
Roadmap traffic lane: Search Console shows /star-map-generator with high impressions but weak average position, while /blog/choose-date-location-custom-star-map already earns meaningful impressions with a stronger position. Add one clear, intent-matched in-body link (plus optional short context line) from that guide to /star-map-generator so crawlers and readers see a tighter topical cluster without starting a broad SEO project.

— proposed by briefing agent on 2026-04-21T23:57:36.308Z
acceptanceCriteria: HTTP GET https://starmapco.com/blog/choose-date-location-custom-star-map returns 200 and the response body includes an HTML anchor href to https://starmapco.com/star-map-generator (relative /star-map-generator is acceptable) inside the main article content area.
testPlan: Fetch the blog URL with curl (follow redirects) and assert the href appears outside nav/footer-only chrome if the page structure allows distinguishing it.
